# Red-path fixture: hand-written counts adjacent to enumerable structures

All three checks run before any database boots:

- frontmatter
- plan graph
- decisions index

The seventeen layers are listed below.

| layer | status |
| --- | --- |
| foundation | ready |

`make check-red` asserts checks/counts.mjs flags both counts: "three
checks" immediately precedes a list and "seventeen layers" immediately
precedes a table, and both nouns are checkable repo structures.
